senses.en: special importance or emphasis given to something
senses.pattern: the accent is on sth / put the accent on sth / with the accent on sth
senses.example: At this cooking school, the [[accent]] is on fresh local ingredients rather than complicated techniques.
senses.example_zh: 這所烹飪學校的重點在於新鮮的在地食材，而不是複雜的技巧。

senses.en: to make something more noticeable
senses.pattern: accent a feature / accent sth with sth / be accented with sth
senses.example: The designer chose bright yellow cushions to [[accent]] the plain gray sofa in the living room.
senses.example_zh: 設計師選了鮮黃色的抱枕，來突顯客廳裡素雅的灰色沙發。
senses.note: 同義詞 accentuate 更常見

senses.en: strange and unfamiliar; very different from what you know
senses.pattern: be alien to sb / an alien culture / an alien environment
senses.example: City life felt [[alien]] to the young farmer, who missed the quiet fields of his hometown.
senses.example_zh: 對這位年輕農夫來說，都市生活十分陌生，他很想念家鄉寧靜的田野。

senses.en: a person who is not a citizen of the country
senses.pattern: a resident alien / a legal alien / the rights of aliens
senses.example: Under the old law, any [[alien]] who stayed longer than ninety days had to register with the police.
senses.example_zh: 依照舊法，凡是停留超過九十天的外國人都必須向警方登記。
senses.note: 法律用語；日常多說 foreigner

senses.en: an idea or memory that something makes you think of
senses.pattern: have associations with sth / word association / pleasant associations
senses.example: For many people, the smell of fresh bread has happy [[associations]] with childhood mornings at home.
senses.example_zh: 對許多人來說，剛出爐麵包的香味會引起美好的聯想，讓人想起童年在家的早晨。

senses.en: a connection or link between two things
senses.pattern: an association between A and B / a close association with sth / in association with sb
senses.example: Researchers found a clear [[association]] between a lack of sleep and poor performance on memory tests.
senses.example_zh: 研究人員發現，睡眠不足與記憶測驗表現不佳之間有明顯的關聯。

gsat.sentence: Recent or repeated exposure to a song or even a small part of a song can also trigger earworms, as can word [[associations]], such as a phrase similar to the lyrics of a song.
The [[association]] of particular patterns with individual families can be traced back hundreds of years.

senses.en: the regular rhythm of a piece of music
senses.pattern: the beat of the drum / dance to the beat / keep the beat / a steady beat
senses.example: The children clapped their hands to the [[beat]] of the drum as the parade passed by.
senses.example_zh: 遊行隊伍經過時，孩子們跟著鼓聲的節拍拍手。

senses.en: very tired; with no energy left
senses.pattern: be dead beat / feel beat / look beat
senses.example: After hiking for ten hours in the rain, we were too [[beat]] to cook dinner.
senses.example_zh: 在雨中健行十個小時後，我們筋疲力盡，連晚餐都沒力氣煮。
senses.note: 口語用法，不放在名詞前

senses.en: a document promising to repay borrowed money with interest
senses.pattern: government bonds / buy bonds / issue bonds / stocks and bonds
senses.example: My grandfather put most of his savings into government [[bonds]] because he considered them safer than stocks.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺把大部分的積蓄拿去買政府債券，因為他認為債券比股票安全。

senses.en: to join two things firmly together
senses.pattern: bond A to B / bond with sth / bond together
senses.example: This glue is strong enough to [[bond]] metal to glass in less than a minute.
senses.example_zh: 這種膠的黏性很強，不到一分鐘就能把金屬和玻璃牢牢黏合。
senses.note: chemical bond 指化學鍵（n.）

gsat.sentence: De Mestral’s first challenge was finding a fabric for a strong [[bonding]] system.

senses.en: the official position or role that someone has
senses.pattern: in one's capacity as / in an official capacity / in a personal capacity
senses.example: She attended the meeting in her [[capacity]] as chair of the student council, not as a friend.
senses.example_zh: 她是以學生會主席的身分出席這場會議，而不是以朋友的身分。

senses.en: the amount that a factory or machine can produce
senses.pattern: at full capacity / production capacity / increase capacity
senses.example: The factory has been running at full [[capacity]] since orders for the new bicycle started pouring in.
senses.example_zh: 自從新款自行車的訂單大量湧入後，這家工廠就一直以最大產能運轉。

senses.en: a small object believed to bring good luck
senses.pattern: a lucky charm / a good-luck charm / wear a charm / a charm bracelet
senses.example: Before every exam, he touches the lucky [[charm]] his grandmother bought for him at a temple.
senses.example_zh: 每次考試前，他都會摸一摸奶奶在廟裡替他求來的護身符。
senses.note: work like a charm＝非常靈驗、有效

gsat.sentence: Other times, a magician may make you a magic [[charm]], or say a spell, to cure you.

senses.en: a group of animals or plants living together
senses.pattern: a colony of ants / a bee colony / a penguin colony / form a colony
senses.example: A single [[colony]] of bees can contain more than fifty thousand workers during the summer.
senses.example_zh: 夏季時，光是一個蜜蜂群體就可能有五萬多隻工蜂。

gsat.sentence: The trails connect the ants’ [[colonies]] and sources of food, forming a sort of communication network.
Small birds such as baby quails are fair game to the expanding [[colony]].

senses.en: trust that a secret will not be told to others
senses.pattern: in confidence / in strict confidence / take sb into one's confidence
senses.example: I'm telling you this in strict [[confidence]], so please don't mention it to anyone in class.
senses.example_zh: 我是在絕對保密的前提下告訴你這件事的，所以請不要跟班上任何人提起。

senses.en: a secret that you tell someone you trust
senses.pattern: share confidences / exchange confidences / betray a confidence
senses.example: The two roommates stayed up late sharing [[confidences]] about their families and their fears.
senses.example_zh: 兩位室友熬夜到很晚，互相吐露關於家庭和內心恐懼的祕密。
senses.note: 此義為可數名詞，常用複數

senses.en: to try hard to win someone's support or business
senses.pattern: court customers / court voters / court sb's support / court publicity
senses.example: Coffee shops near the campus are [[courting]] students with cheap breakfast sets and free wireless internet.
senses.example_zh: 校園附近的咖啡店推出便宜的早餐套餐和免費無線網路，極力爭取學生顧客。
senses.note: court disaster＝自招災禍

senses.en: the place where a king or queen lives and rules
senses.pattern: the royal court / at court / the court of the emperor
senses.example: The young musician was invited to perform at the royal [[court]] when he was only six.
senses.example_zh: 這位年輕的音樂家年僅六歲就受邀到王室宮廷演奏。

gsat.sentence: A lover of tea since her childhood in Portugal, she brought tea-drinking to the English royal [[court]] and set a trend for the beverage in the seventeenth century.
By the 7th century A.D., royal [[courts]] of the Middle East began to use forks at the table for dining.

senses.en: to give a speech or talk to an audience
senses.pattern: deliver a speech / deliver a lecture / deliver a talk
senses.example: The principal will [[deliver]] a short speech at the graduation ceremony next Friday morning.
senses.example_zh: 校長將在下週五早上的畢業典禮上發表簡短的演說。

senses.en: to help a baby be born; to give birth
senses.pattern: deliver a baby / deliver twins / be delivered by a doctor
senses.example: The doctor on duty that night [[delivered]] three babies before the sun came up.
senses.example_zh: 那晚值班的醫生在天亮前接生了三個寶寶。

senses.en: to do what you promised or are expected to
senses.pattern: deliver on a promise / fail to deliver / deliver results
senses.example: The company promised faster service, but so far it has failed to [[deliver]] on that promise.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司承諾提供更快速的服務，但到目前為止都未能履行承諾。

gsat.sentence: After [[delivering]] a very powerful speech, the award winner was surrounded by a group of fans asking for her signature.
Pregnant elephants avoid [[delivering]] babies in the tea gardens for fear of being disturbed.

senses.en: to be spread over an area in many places
senses.pattern: dot the landscape / dot the coastline / be dotted with sth
senses.example: Small fishing villages [[dot]] the coastline, each with its own colorful harbor.
senses.example_zh: 一座座小漁村散布於海岸線上，各自擁有色彩繽紛的港口。
senses.note: 常用被動 be dotted with

senses.en: to use a method, skill, or tool
senses.pattern: employ a method / employ a strategy / employ a technique
senses.example: The detective [[employed]] a clever trick to make the thief reveal where the painting was hidden.
senses.example_zh: 偵探運用了一個巧妙的計策，讓小偷說出畫藏在哪裡。
senses.note: 正式用語，相當於 use

gsat.sentence: Different methods have been [[employed]] by economists to measure standard of living.

senses.en: an actor with a small non-speaking part in a film
senses.pattern: work as an extra / hire extras / a film extra
senses.example: Hundreds of local residents were hired as [[extras]] for the crowd scenes in the historical film.
senses.example_zh: 數百名當地居民受雇擔任臨時演員，參與這部歷史片中的群眾場面。

senses.en: something added that you must pay more for
senses.pattern: optional extras / pay for extras / no hidden extras
senses.example: The basic price of the tour is low, but meals and museum tickets are [[extras]].
senses.example_zh: 這個行程的基本價格很低，但餐費和博物館門票都是額外收費的項目。

senses.en: a person, especially a well-known or important one
senses.pattern: a public figure / a leading figure / a key figure / a historical figure
senses.example: The retired teacher remains a respected [[figure]] in the village, and people still ask her for advice.
senses.example_zh: 這位退休教師在村裡仍是備受敬重的人物，大家還是會向她請教。

senses.en: the shape of a person's body
senses.pattern: a slim figure / keep one's figure / watch one's figure
senses.example: The dancer keeps her slim [[figure]] by swimming every morning and avoiding sugary drinks.
senses.example_zh: 這位舞者靠著每天早上游泳、不喝含糖飲料來保持苗條的身材。

senses.en: to think or guess that something is true
senses.pattern: figure (that) … / I figured as much
senses.example: When the lights stayed off all evening, we [[figured]] that the neighbors had gone on vacation.
senses.example_zh: 看到燈整晚都沒亮，我們料想鄰居是去度假了。
senses.note: 口語用法，多見於美式英語

gsat.sentence: Henri Cartier-Bresson (1908–2004) is one of the most original and influential [[figures]] in the history of photography.
People who desire a slender [[figure]] should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.

senses.en: to send a letter or message on to someone
senses.pattern: forward an email to sb / forward a message / forward mail to a new address
senses.example: Could you [[forward]] the teacher's email to me? I seem to have deleted it by mistake.
senses.example_zh: 你可以把老師的電子郵件轉寄給我嗎？我好像不小心把它刪掉了。

senses.en: an attacking player in a team sport
senses.pattern: play forward / a center forward / a star forward
senses.example: The team's tallest [[forward]] scored twice in the last five minutes of the match.
senses.example_zh: 該隊最高的前鋒在比賽最後五分鐘內兩度得分。

gsat.sentence: Your address was [[forwarded]] to us by Why Bother Magazine.

senses.en: a tiny hard piece of sand, salt, or sugar
senses.pattern: a grain of sand / a grain of salt / grains of sugar
senses.example: After a day at the beach, I found [[grains]] of sand in my shoes, my bag, and even my hair.
senses.example_zh: 在海邊玩了一天後，我發現鞋子裡、包包裡，甚至頭髮裡都有一顆顆的沙粒。

senses.en: a very small amount of a quality
senses.pattern: a grain of truth / a grain of hope / not a grain of sense
senses.example: The rumor sounds ridiculous, but there may be a [[grain]] of truth in it.
senses.example_zh: 這個傳言聽起來很荒謬，但其中或許有一點點真實性。
senses.note: against the grain＝違背本性（grain 指木紋）

senses.en: a device in a vehicle that makes a loud warning sound
senses.pattern: sound the horn / honk the horn / a car horn
senses.example: The taxi driver sounded his [[horn]] angrily when a scooter suddenly cut in front of him.
senses.example_zh: 一輛機車突然切到前面時，計程車司機氣得猛按喇叭。

senses.en: a brass musical instrument that you blow into
senses.pattern: play the horn / a French horn / blow a horn
senses.example: My cousin plays the French [[horn]] in the school orchestra and practices every evening.
senses.example_zh: 我表哥在學校管弦樂團吹法國號，每天晚上都會練習。

senses.en: one of a regular series of magazines or newspapers
senses.pattern: the latest issue / the current issue / a back issue / a special issue
senses.example: The latest [[issue]] of the science magazine has a ten-page special report on black holes.
senses.example_zh: 這本科學雜誌的最新一期有長達十頁的黑洞專題報導。

senses.en: to officially announce something or give something out
senses.pattern: issue a warning / issue a statement / issue a passport / issue a visa
senses.example: The weather bureau [[issued]] a heavy rain warning for the mountain areas this afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 氣象局今天下午對山區發布了豪雨特報。

gsat.sentence: The latest [[issue]] of a magazine.

In medieval Europe, on the other hand, travel documents were [[issued]] by local authorities, and generally contained a list of towns and cities which the document holder was permitted to enter or pass through.

senses.en: one part or stage of a journey or race
senses.pattern: the first leg / the final leg of a journey / the second leg of the race
senses.example: The final [[leg]] of our trip took us from Lisbon to Madrid by overnight train.
senses.example_zh: 我們旅程的最後一段是搭夜車從里斯本到馬德里。

senses.en: to cope with a difficult situation, especially with little money
senses.pattern: manage on sth / manage without sth / manage on one's own
senses.example: After her father lost his job, the family had to [[manage]] on a much smaller income.
senses.example_zh: 她父親失業後，全家只好靠少得多的收入勉強度日。

senses.zh: 勉強做到；擠出（笑容、時間）
senses.en: to succeed in producing or doing something difficult
senses.pattern: manage a smile / manage a few words / can't manage Friday
senses.example: Although she was deeply disappointed with the result, the runner [[managed]] a smile for the cameras.
senses.example_zh: 儘管對結果非常失望，這位跑者仍對著鏡頭勉強擠出一個微笑。
senses.note: manage to V＝設法做到（熟義）

gsat.sentence: All the obstacles of reality can be set aside and you are able to accomplish tasks that you could never [[manage]] in waking reality.

senses.en: to match or show something very closely
senses.pattern: mirror the trend / mirror reality / closely mirror sth / be mirrored in sth
senses.example: The mood of the novel [[mirrors]] the author's own lonely childhood in a small mining town.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說的氛圍反映了作者在礦業小鎮度過的孤單童年。

senses.en: remaining after tax or costs are taken away
senses.pattern: net profit / net income / net weight / net loss
senses.example: The label says the [[net]] weight of the cookies is 200 grams, not including the tin box.
senses.example_zh: 標籤上寫著這盒餅乾的淨重是兩百公克，不含鐵盒。
senses.note: 反義詞為 gross（總的、毛的）

senses.en: to earn an amount of money as profit
senses.pattern: net a profit / net sb sth / net millions
senses.example: The charity concert [[netted]] over two million dollars for the children's hospital.
senses.example_zh: 這場慈善音樂會為兒童醫院淨賺了兩百多萬元。

senses.en: of the mouth; taken by mouth
senses.pattern: oral health / oral hygiene / oral cancer / oral medication
senses.example: Dentists remind us that good [[oral]] health depends on brushing twice a day and eating less sugar.
senses.example_zh: 牙醫提醒我們，良好的口腔健康有賴於每天刷牙兩次並少吃糖。

senses.en: a spoken examination, especially in a foreign language
senses.pattern: a French oral / take an oral / pass the oral
senses.example: She was so nervous before her French [[oral]] that she could hardly eat breakfast.
senses.example_zh: 她在法文口試前緊張到幾乎吃不下早餐。
senses.note: 主要為英式用法

senses.en: one of the sides in an agreement or dispute
senses.pattern: both parties / the other party / a third party / the parties involved
senses.example: If either [[party]] breaks the agreement, the other can ask for the deposit to be returned.
senses.example_zh: 如果任何一方違反協議，另一方可以要求退還訂金。

senses.en: a group of people doing something together
senses.pattern: a search party / a rescue party / a party of four
senses.example: A rescue [[party]] of twelve climbers set out at dawn to look for the missing hikers.
senses.example_zh: 由十二名登山好手組成的搜救隊伍在黎明時出發，尋找失蹤的登山客。

gsat.sentence: Both [[parties]] can sign an agreement beforehand.
One can damage the home of the other [[party]] in return.

senses.en: easily shaped or changed
senses.pattern: highly plastic / remain plastic / a plastic material
senses.example: Young children's brains are highly [[plastic]], which is why they pick up new languages so easily.
senses.example_zh: 幼兒的大腦可塑性極高，這就是他們學新語言學得這麼輕鬆的原因。
senses.note: 名詞 plasticity；plastic surgery 整形手術

senses.en: seeming artificial; not real or sincere
senses.pattern: a plastic smile / look plastic / sound plastic
senses.example: The host greeted every guest with the same [[plastic]] smile and then quickly looked away.
senses.example_zh: 主持人用同樣虛假的笑容迎接每位來賓，隨即把目光移開。
senses.note: 含貶義

senses.en: an area where wild animals or plants are protected
senses.pattern: a wildlife preserve / a nature preserve / a forest preserve
senses.example: Hunting is strictly forbidden inside the wildlife [[preserve]], where hundreds of deer roam freely.
senses.example_zh: 野生動物保護區內嚴禁打獵，數百頭鹿在裡面自由漫步。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式多用 reserve

senses.en: an activity or area limited to one group
senses.pattern: the preserve of the rich / a male preserve / remain the preserve of sb
senses.example: A century ago, university education was largely the [[preserve]] of wealthy families.
senses.example_zh: 一百年前，大學教育大多是富裕家庭的專屬領域。
senses.note: 複數 preserves 另指果醬、蜜餞

senses.en: to turn out to be something
senses.pattern: prove (to be) useful / prove difficult / prove fatal / prove a success
senses.example: The new bus route [[proved]] popular with students who live far from the school.
senses.example_zh: 新的公車路線結果大受住得離學校較遠的學生歡迎。
senses.note: 後接形容詞或名詞作補語

gsat.sentence: He first tried cotton, but it [[proved]] too soft and could not withstand repeated openings and closures.
Cross-field collaboration has [[proved]] to be very fruitful for 100% Fish.

senses.en: higher, lower, or better than ever before
senses.pattern: a record number of / a record high / a record low / in record time
senses.example: Farmers in the region enjoyed a [[record]] harvest this year thanks to plenty of rain in spring.
senses.example_zh: 多虧春季雨水充足，這個地區的農民今年迎來創紀錄的大豐收。
senses.note: 只放在名詞前

senses.en: the known facts about someone's past behavior
senses.pattern: a criminal record / a clean record / a track record / an academic record
senses.example: Because he had no criminal [[record]], the judge gave the young man a second chance.
senses.example_zh: 由於這名年輕人沒有前科，法官給了他一次改過的機會。

gsat.sentence: As a [[record]] number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were choked with traffic all day.

senses.en: one complete circular movement around a point
senses.pattern: one revolution around the sun / revolutions per minute / make a full revolution
senses.example: The Earth completes one [[revolution]] around the Sun in about 365 days.
senses.example_zh: 地球繞太陽公轉一圈大約需要三百六十五天。
senses.note: 動詞 revolve；rpm＝每分鐘轉數

senses.en: the place where an accident or crime happened
senses.pattern: the scene of the accident / at the scene / a crime scene / arrive on the scene
senses.example: Firefighters arrived at the [[scene]] within five minutes and quickly put out the flames.
senses.example_zh: 消防隊員在五分鐘內趕到現場，迅速撲滅了火勢。

senses.en: a particular area of activity and its people
senses.pattern: the music scene / the art scene / the fashion scene
senses.example: The city's lively music [[scene]] attracts young bands from all over the country.
senses.example_zh: 這座城市活躍的音樂圈子吸引了全國各地的年輕樂團。

senses.en: a loud, angry argument or outburst in public
senses.pattern: make a scene / cause a scene / create a scene
senses.example: The little boy made a [[scene]] in the supermarket when his mother refused to buy him candy.
senses.example_zh: 媽媽不肯買糖果給他，小男孩就在超市裡當眾吵鬧。

senses.en: to choose something after thinking about it
senses.pattern: settle on a name / settle on a date / finally settle on sth
senses.example: After trying on a dozen dresses, she finally [[settled]] on a simple blue one for the dance.
senses.example_zh: 試穿了十幾件洋裝後，她最後選定一件簡單的藍色洋裝去參加舞會。
senses.note: 比較 settle for＝勉強接受

senses.en: to come down and rest on a surface
senses.pattern: dust settles / snow settles on sth / settle on a branch
senses.example: A thin layer of dust had [[settled]] on the piano that nobody had played for years.
senses.example_zh: 那架多年沒人彈的鋼琴上，已經落下一層薄薄的灰塵。

senses.en: to pay the money that you owe
senses.pattern: settle a bill / settle a debt / settle an account
senses.example: Please [[settle]] your hotel bill at the front desk before you leave for the airport.
senses.example_zh: 前往機場前，請先到櫃檯結清您的住宿費用。

gsat.sentence: After years of research and testing, he learned that synthetics worked best and eventually [[settled]] on heat-treated nylon, a strong and durable substance.
Standing on the seashore, we saw a flock of seagulls flying over the ocean before they glided down and [[settled]] on the water.

senses.en: to be in a particular place or position
senses.pattern: sit on a hill / sit at the foot of sth / sit in the heart of sth
senses.example: The old temple [[sits]] on a hill overlooking the harbor and the fishing boats below.
senses.example_zh: 這座古廟坐落在山丘上，俯瞰著港口和下方的漁船。

senses.en: to be a member of a committee or board
senses.pattern: sit on a committee / sit on a board / sit on a jury
senses.example: Two students were chosen to [[sit]] on the committee that plans the school anniversary celebration.
senses.example_zh: 兩名學生獲選擔任校慶籌備委員會的成員。

gsat.sentence: In 1499, he arrived at Zanzibar, an archipelago [[sitting]] at the crossroads of the Spice Route.

senses.en: to cause something to start or develop suddenly
senses.pattern: spark a debate / spark interest / spark an idea / spark anger
senses.example: The science teacher's simple experiment with magnets [[sparked]] my lifelong interest in physics.
senses.example_zh: 自然老師用磁鐵做的簡單實驗，激起了我對物理一輩子的興趣。

gsat.sentence: It is believed that taking breaks from a problem can help [[spark]] a moment of insight or stimulate new ideas.

senses.en: to keep following a plan, rule, or promise
senses.pattern: stick to a plan / stick to the rules / stick to a budget / stick to one's promise
senses.example: If you [[stick]] to your study plan for a month, your grades will surely improve.
senses.example_zh: 只要你堅持照著讀書計畫做一個月，成績一定會進步。
senses.note: 此義須接 to；三態 stick–stuck–stuck

senses.en: to push a pointed object into something
senses.pattern: stick a needle into sth / stick a fork in sth / stick a pin in sth
senses.example: Be careful not to [[stick]] the needle into your finger while you are sewing on the button.
senses.example_zh: 縫鈕扣的時候要小心，別把針刺入手指。

gsat.sentence: To [[stick]] to a tight budget, Robert bought a more affordable LED TV instead of a fancy, expensive 3D TV.
Being vegan means I try to [[stick]] to plant food.

senses.en: the most important or essential part of something
senses.pattern: in substance / the substance of sth / lack substance / style over substance
senses.example: The two reports differ in style, but in [[substance]] they say exactly the same thing.
senses.example_zh: 這兩份報告風格不同，但就實質內容而言，說的完全是同一件事。

senses.en: the quality of being based on facts or truth
senses.pattern: without substance / no substance to sth / give substance to sth
senses.example: The school said there was no [[substance]] to the rumor that the trip had been canceled.
senses.example_zh: 校方表示，旅行已經取消的傳言毫無事實根據。

senses.en: a device that controls the flow of water
senses.pattern: turn on the tap / turn off the tap / tap water / a dripping tap
senses.example: Remember to turn off the [[tap]] while you are brushing your teeth to save water.
senses.example_zh: 刷牙時記得關掉水龍頭，以節約用水。
senses.note: 美式常用 faucet；tap water＝自來水

senses.en: to make use of a resource or supply
senses.pattern: tap natural resources / tap a new market / tap sb's talent
senses.example: The island hopes to [[tap]] its strong ocean winds to produce clean electricity.
senses.example_zh: 這座島嶼希望利用強勁的海風來生產乾淨的電力。
senses.note: 亦作 tap into（vi.）

gsat.sentence: Many people like to drink bottled water because they feel that [[tap]] water may not be safe, but is bottled water really any better?

senses.en: complete; absolute
senses.pattern: a total failure / total darkness / a total stranger / total silence
senses.example: The surprise party was a [[total]] failure because the birthday girl had already heard about it.
senses.example_zh: 這場驚喜派對是個徹底的失敗，因為壽星早就聽說了這件事。

senses.en: to reach a particular total amount
senses.pattern: total $500 / total over a million / total nearly 300
senses.example: Donations to the animal shelter [[totaled]] nearly three million dollars by the end of the year.
senses.example_zh: 到年底時，動物收容所收到的捐款總計達將近三百萬元。
senses.note: 英式拼法為 totalled

gsat.sentence: Global sales of hard hats [[totaled]] USD 2.1 billion in 2016, and are expected to reach USD 3.19 billion in 2025.

senses.en: to believe something because you have been told it
senses.pattern: I understand (that) … / it is understood that … / be given to understand
senses.example: I [[understand]] from your teacher that you are planning to study abroad next year.
senses.example_zh: 我從你的老師那裡聽說，你打算明年出國念書。

senses.en: to agree on something without saying it
senses.pattern: it is understood that … / it was understood between us / be clearly understood
senses.example: It was [[understood]] that whoever got home first would start cooking, though nobody ever said so.
senses.example_zh: 雖然沒人明說，但大家都有默契：誰先到家就由誰開始煮飯。
senses.note: 常用被動 it is understood that

senses.en: to consider something carefully before deciding
senses.pattern: weigh the pros and cons / weigh A against B / weigh (up) the options / weigh the risks
senses.example: You should [[weigh]] the pros and cons carefully before you decide to quit the school team.
senses.example_zh: 在決定退出校隊之前，你應該仔細權衡利弊得失。

senses.en: to make someone feel worried or sad
senses.pattern: weigh on sb's mind / weigh heavily on sb / weigh on sb's conscience
senses.example: The argument with his best friend [[weighed]] on his mind throughout the long weekend.
senses.example_zh: 和最好的朋友吵架這件事，整個連假都壓在他的心頭。
senses.note: 此義須接 on

quiz.stem: A short video of students cleaning a polluted beach ______ a nationwide movement, inspiring thousands of volunteers to organize similar events in their own towns.
quiz.explain_zh: spark＝引發。學生淨灘的短片引發全國性的行動，許多志工起而效法。

quiz.stem: The cyclists were already exhausted, but the toughest ______ of the race, a steep climb to the mountain top, still lay ahead of them.
quiz.explain_zh: leg＝（比賽的）一段。最艱難的一段賽程是爬上山頂的陡坡，還在後頭。

quiz.stem: The school fair brought in sixty thousand dollars, but after all the expenses were paid, the ______ profit was only half that amount.
quiz.explain_zh: net＝淨的。園遊會收入六萬元，扣除所有開銷後的淨利只剩一半。

quiz.stem: Before choosing a university, Hannah carefully ______ the advantages of living at home against the excitement of studying in a big city.
quiz.explain_zh: weigh＝權衡。選大學前，她仔細權衡住家裡的好處與到大城市念書的吸引力。

quiz.stem: The judge urged both ______ in the dispute to sit down and reach an agreement instead of spending more money on lawyers.
quiz.explain_zh: party＝（爭端的）一方。法官勸爭端雙方坐下來達成協議，別再花錢請律師。

quiz.stem: Scientists have found that the number of birds on the island closely ______ changes in the local climate, rising in warm years and falling in cold ones.
quiz.explain_zh: mirror＝反映、與…極為相似。島上鳥類的數量緊跟著當地氣候的變化而增減。

quiz.stem: Lisa was upset to learn that the secret she had told her best friend in ______ had been shared with the whole class.
quiz.explain_zh: confidence＝保密；in confidence 指私下、祕密地告知。她只告訴好友的祕密竟傳遍全班。

quiz.stem: Having lived in a mountain village all her life, Grandma finds the idea of paying for everything with a phone completely ______.
quiz.explain_zh: alien＝陌生的。奶奶一輩子住在山村，覺得用手機付款的觀念十分陌生。

quiz.stem: My article on night markets will appear in the next ______ of the school magazine, which comes out at the end of this month.
quiz.explain_zh: issue＝（刊物的）一期。我的文章會刊登在月底出刊的下一期校刊上。

quiz.stem: Seen from the airplane window, the green valley was ______ with hundreds of small white houses, each surrounded by its own fruit trees.
quiz.explain_zh: dot＝散布於、點綴。從機窗往下看，翠綠的山谷中散布著數百間小白屋。
